The academy was renowned for its rigorous magical curriculum and strict adherence to elven traditions. Elven students, mostly from noble or high-ranking families, attended the academy to hone their magical abilities and uphold the elven heritage. The academy was divided into several houses, each representing a different aspect of elven culture. Aethereia, being a member of the royal family, was a part of the House of Eldrida, known for their fierce pride and superiority complex. The academy's architecture was a blend of elegant spires and grand halls, reflecting the elves' affinity for nature and magic. The atmosphere was often tense, with an undercurrent of competition and elitism. Humans were rarely seen within the academy's walls, and when they were, it was usually in subservient roles.
